description: Reviewed readings for plain Ancient spellings whose only source reading was a hyphenated lemma (#137). build_lookup_db.py drops a corpus pair under a hyphenated lemma unless it names a listed compound, which left these forms without a row. Each record gives the corpus lemma it replaces and the head a headword list has for the word; a form is read only where the lookup has no row of its own for it. The other spellings of the #137 gap stay without an answer: their corpus lemma is garbled beyond a clear head (ὀυ-δ̔έπωδυνω, ὕ-πτυχͅσκω), the token is two words written as one (μετεξέτεροίτε, ἐυπρήσσοντας) or a misprint (δελήλωνται), or no head list has the compound (κατενίσατο, ἐπισυνήρτυεν).
